name: Equal angles
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 4, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 3)
    *point(D = 7, 0)
    *point(E = 11, 0)
    *point(F = 9, 3)
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *triangle(D ; E ; F)
    *equal-angle(A ; B ; C ; D ; E ; F)
)

name: Parallel lines
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 5, 0)
    *point(C = 1, 3)
    *point(D)
    *parallel(A ; B ; C ; D)
    *distance(C ; D ; 5)
    *line(A ; B)
    *line(C ; D)
)

name: Perpendicular
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 4, 0)
    *point(C)
    *distance(A ; C ; 3)
    *perp(A ; B ; A ; C)
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *right-angle(B ; A ; C)
)

name: Equal lengths
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C)
    *equal-length(A ; C ; B ; C)
    *distance(A ; C ; 5)
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
)

name: Intersection
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 5, 0)
    *point(C = 0, 4)
    *point(D = 5, 4)
    *intersection(P ; line(A ; D) ; line(B ; C))
    *line(A ; D)
    *line(B ; C)
)

name: Angle measure
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 6, 4)
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *right-angle(A ; B ; C)
    *angle-value(B ; A ; C)
)

name: Foot of a perpendicular
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 4)
    *point(F = foot(A ; line(B ; C)))
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *line(A ; F)
)

name: Intersection (constructed)
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 0, 4)
    *point(D = 6, 4)
    *point(P = intersect(line(A ; D) ; line(B ; C)))
    *line(A ; D)
    *line(B ; C)
)

name: Triangle centroid
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 4)
    *point(G = centroid(A ; B ; C))
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *line(A ; G)
)

name: Triangle circumcenter
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 4)
    *point(O = circumcenter(A ; B ; C))
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *circle(O ; A)
)

name: Triangle incenter
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 4)
    *point(I = incenter(A ; B ; C))
    *triangle(A ; B ; C)
    *line(A ; I)
)

name: Triangle orthocenter
code:
*draw(
    *point(A = 0, 0)
    *point(B = 6, 0)
    *point(C = 2, 4)
    *point(H = orthocenter(A ; B ; C))
